headline: 💉 West Pharma Ransomware, 🤖 Cline AI RCE, 📦 Mini Shai-Hulud Escalates, 🔒 Patch Tuesday Clean, 📧 Exim Dead.Letter
summary: West Pharmaceutical hit by disruptive ransomware halting global operations. Critical unpatched RCE in Cline AI coding assistant (CVE-2026-44211). Mini Shai-Hulud supply chain attack escalates with signed provenance bypass. Microsoft Patch Tuesday is clean for first time in two years. Exim Dead.Letter unauthenticated RCE threatens internet mail servers.
